def.label: 105 mm cannon
def.note: Doc 49 unit CC.2's cycle (Q-49-3): one round every 15,000 ms, thirty Engaged pulses between rounds, the main decision of a duel; with the 24-round load (Q-49-22) that is six minutes of fire. The bands and the muzzle speed are cut C's: 3 km, longer than the 2.56 km arena's diagonal, so range never ends an engagement on this map, with the inner band at 1.5 km; and 1 km/s, so a shot across the whole arena is about 2.5 s in flight.
